items.title: Schedule recurring agent tasks in the cloud
items.description: Schedule agent tasks from the Console or sbx CLI without keeping your machine online. Each run starts in a fresh cloud sandbox, which is deleted when the task finishes or reaches its time limit.

items.title: Use Docker VMM on Linux
items.description: Docker VMM (Beta) is available on Linux with KVM access. Select it in Docker Desktop settings to use Docker's container-optimized virtual machine manager.

items.title: Run containers in persistent cloud sandboxes
items.description: Run Docker CLI and Compose workloads in cloud sandboxes that preserve containers, images, and volumes across pauses. Docker Offload is included with Docker Agentic Platform for individual developers, with usage-based billing.

items.title: Store mirrored and customized images in the EU
items.description: Request a Docker Hardened Images subscription in the EU region to store mirrored and customized images and their build attestations in the EU.

items.title: Assign licenses to teams
items.description: Assign a product license to a team so every current and future member receives it. The Licenses page in Docker Home shows available licenses and whether they are assigned to teams or individuals.

items.title: Compose sandbox environments with kits v3
items.description: Build sandbox environments from workload and mixin kits, combine them into reusable kit sets, and publish the result as a container image.

items.title: Give coding agents guidance with Docker Skills
items.description: Install Docker's official open-source skills in compatible coding agents to give them guidance for Dockerfiles, Compose applications, and other Docker tasks.

items.title: Run sandboxes on Docker-managed cloud infrastructure
items.description: Run sandboxes on Docker-managed cloud infrastructure using the Console or sbx CLI. An API and TypeScript SDK support commands, file transfers, and resource management from applications.
